scope: All public citation URLs in the three articles were requested. The 13 replacement sources in The Body Keeps the Receipts were checked for identity and support of the stated claims. Companion references were also reviewed for the retained general context.
limitations: Citation verification does not verify the personal events, symptoms, institutional motives, or records-search results.
Publisher and NCBI bot challenges are access limitations, not findings that the citation is false.
Redacted district URLs cannot be verified from this public checkout; no attempt was made to identify the district.
